snippet.title: HYPERLANE HIGHWAY - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Hyperlane Highway is now available to wishlist on the Meta Quest store, launching Q4 2026. It's a VR hoverboard roguelite where you lean your whole body to steer through neon hyperlanes, dual wielding blasters with independent aim in each hand. Dodge escalating enemy fire, build a loadout from a deep pool of roguelite upgrades, and push deeper every run. Made solo in Dublin, also wishlistable on Steam, with playtesting open now through the Discord.
